title: Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
abstract: arXiv:2611.17098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines. To power them, firms connect to the commercial grid or contract generation directly, but interconnection and gas-turbine delays now incentivize on-site generation. We compare grid-connected and off-grid data center energy infrastructure (AC- and DC-coupled solar-plus-storage, islanded natural gas, and grid interconnection) across the continental U.S. Using an open-source technoeconomic framework built on empirically calibrated AI training loads, climate-driven cooling, stage-by-stage power conversion, and physics-based battery degradation, we model designs providing equivalent energy services. Our central contribution is a speed-adjusted cost of energy that values the compute unlocked by faster construction, making options with different deployment timelines directly comparable on one physically consistent

translated_title: 供电速度主导AI数据中心的能源成本：美国大陆地区AI供电的技术经济分析
translated_abstract: 人工智能的快速发展正推动对大规模、短部署周期的新型数据中心的需求。为了给这些数据中心供电，企业通常选择接入商业电网或直接签订发电合同，但如今并网审批和燃气轮机交付的延迟正在促使企业转向现场自建发电。本文在美国大陆范围内比较了并网与离网数据中心的能源基础设施方案，包括交流耦合与直流耦合的“太阳能+储能”系统、孤岛式天然气发电以及电网接入。研究基于一个开源技术经济框架，该框架结合了经验校准的AI训练负载、气候驱动的制冷需求、逐级电力转换以及基于物理模型的电池退化，对提供同等能源服务的各设计方案进行建模。本文的核心贡献是提出了一种“速度调整后的能源成本”指标，它将为更快建设速度所解锁的算力价值纳入考量，使得不同部署时间线的供电方案能够在统一的物理一致性基础上进行直接比较。
tldr: 本文提出“速度调整后的能源成本”这一核心指标，通过对美国大陆并网与离网AI数据中心供电方案的技术经济比较，证明建设部署速度（而非单纯度电成本）才是决定AI数据中心能源方案选择的主导因素。
